newsitem.title: USA: San Francisco area home sales mixed in January.
newsitem.headline: San Francisco area home sales mixed in January.

text.p: San Francisco Bay area home sales were mixed in January, down sharply from Demember but up nearly 10 percent from January a year ago, according to a report released on Friday.

A total of 3,681 resale houses were sold in the nine-county Bay area last month, down 21.6 percent from 4,695 for December and up 9.5 percent from 3,362 for January a year ago, DataQuick Information Systems reported.
A decline from December to January is normal for the season, DataQuick said.

The median price paid for a resale house in the Bay area was $233,000 last month, up 0.9 percent from December's $231,000 and up 6.4 percent from $219,000 for January a year ago, according to DataQuick, which monitors real estate purchasing and financing nationwide.
